append.detail: Slice 2 shipped (lib/hunts/run-store.ts): load the published Trail by slug (never the open draft; live and paused Hunts only; private Hunts are not found), start or resume a run with a lost-race re-read, and read a run's credited stops scoped to its owner. The play page (app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/page.tsx), the claim action wiring hunt_claim_apply, list/map and hints remain open.
